content:
歡迎！

這是一個簡單且偏向原版風格的整合包，加入了更多生物群系、地牢、首領與難度更高的怪物。遊戲中也包含如暮色森林般的維度空間，大多數首領都會在這些地方出現。你也可以使用 Meet Your Fight 模組製作類似《泰拉瑞亞》的首領召喚道具。別忘了搭配 Minecraft Comes Alive Reborn 模組，你還能安家立業、組建家庭！ 

 

模組列表：

Just Enough Items (JEI) MCA Reborn [Fabric/Forge] AppleSkin Architectury API (Fabric/Forge) bad packets Balm (Forge Edition) Better Fps - Render Distance[Forge] Biomes O' Plenty Blueprint Brutal Bosses - Dungeon Bosses Caelus API (Forge) Cloth Config API (Fabric/Forge) Corail Tombstone Crafting Tweaks Croptopia Curios API (Forge) Duckling Dungeon Crawl Durability Tooltip Elytra Slot (Forge) Fantasy's Furniture GeckoLib JourneyMap Light Overlay (Rift/Forge/Fabric) Meet Your Fight Mob Catcher [FABRIC/FORGE] Mob  Grinding Utils Naturalist Savage & Ravage Simple Storage Network Simply Backpacks Squat Grow (Shift / Twerk to grow plants) SuperMartijn642's Config Lib TerraBlender (Forge) The Twilight Forest When Dungeons Arise - Forge!
